label: Тяжелый / Легкий
description: Weight contrasts that work for objects, bags, books, and load-bearing language.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Тяжёлая' takes the feminine nominative ending to match 'сумка'. 2. 'Очень' adds natural emphasis. 3. A common everyday complaint about a heavy bag.
Strategic focus: Masculine agreement. 1. 'Лёгкий' takes the masculine nominative ending to match 'рюкзак'. 2. 'Совсем' reinforces the lightness. 3. A clean opposite to the heavy bag above.

missions.phrase: Эта тяжёлая книга лежит на столе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Тяжёлая' matches the feminine noun 'книга' in the nominative. 2. The verb 'лежит' anchors a real scene. 3. Concrete and easy to picture for daily vocabulary.

Strategic focus: Neuter agreement. 1. 'Лёгкое' takes the neuter nominative ending to match 'письмо'. 2. The verb 'написал' makes it a full action. 3. Reinforces the neuter adjective ending in context.

missions.phrase: Здесь лежит тяжёлый камень и лёгкая палка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Two-gender comparison. 1. 'Тяжёлый' matches masculine 'камень', 'лёгкая' matches feminine 'палка'. 2. The pair forces two different endings side by side. 3. A strong visual contrast for mixed drills.
